title_sq: Vile per shitje ne Rolling Hills 2!
description_sq:
Vile Individuale në shitje 2 kateshe + bodrum, me siperfaqe totale ndertimi 490 m2 dhe parcele 520 m2, parkim per 2 makina. Kati nentoke ofron ambient argetimi ose palester, dhome gjumi me garderobe dhe tualet, dhome teknike, tualeti i katit dhe lavanderi. Kati perdhe ofron ambient ndenje dhe ngrenie, kuzhine e vecuar dhe ngrenie, dhome gjumi per miqte me tualet, tualet i katit perdhe dhe verande e mbuluar. Kati i pare ofron dhome matrimoniale me gardrobe, tualet dhe verande, dy dhoma gjumi per femije te dyja me garderobe dhe tualet personal. Vila ka dhe pishine.
Rezidenca eshte parashikuar te perfundoje ne 2025.
title_en: Villa for sale in Rolling Hills 2!
description_en: Individual villa for sale, 2 floors + basement, with a total construction area of ​​490 m2 and a plot of 520 m2, parking for 2 cars. The basement floor offers an entertainment area or gym, bedroom with wardrobe and toilet, technical room, floor toilet and laundry. The ground floor offers a living and dining area, a separate kitchen and dining area, a guest bedroom with en-suite bathroom, a ground floor toilet and a covered veranda. The first floor offers a matrimonial room with wardrobe, toilet and veranda, two bedrooms for children, both with wardrobe and personal toilet. The villa has a swimming pool. The residence is expected to be completed in 2025.
